thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to add a small set of runtime/infra metrics to the Console dashboards and wire alerting into oncall. Main metrics: prefix_kv_cache_hit_ratio, batch_size_p50/p95, inflight_requests_by_priority. Goal: detect perf regressions and SLO burn early. cc @kevin @anika

kevin: SG. Do we want separate alerts for cache drop vs SLO burn? they have different remediation. :thinking_face:

anika: yes separate. cache hit < 65% for 5m should warn, <50% for 3m critical. SLO burn rate rules separate (see below).

maria: exact thresholds: cache warn 65 (5m), cache sev1 50 (3m). batch p95 > 1.5s for 10m => warn, >3s for 5m => page. inflight high priority queue length > 250 => page.

sam: proposed Prom rule for SLO burn (pseudocode):
```
- alert: SLOBurn_High_RuntimeRequests
  expr: burnrate_over_time(requests_slo_error_total[5m], 5m) > 4
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-slo-burn
    summary: "Runtime SLO burn >4x over 5m"
```

jess: +1 but we need the alert to include model-route and region tags so we can route to the right oncall team. Add labels: route, region.

kevin: for pager routing: primary -> pagerduty service `redwood-runtime-prod` (eng-oncall). If no ack in 10m escalate to `redwood-sre` (eng-sre). For cache sev1 route direct to eng-platform escalation policy. Need these in Alertmanager route: receiver + group_by [route, region].

anika: here's a minimal Alertmanager route snippet to attach to alerts (copy-paste):
```yaml
route:
  receiver: "pagerduty-runtime"
  group_by: ["route", "region"]
  routes:
    - match:
        severity: "page"
      receiver: "pagerduty-runtime"
      continue: false
receivers:
  - name: "pagerduty-runtime"
    pagerduty_configs:
      - service_key: "<redwood-runtime-prod-key>"
        severity: "critical"
```

maria: add runbook link to cache alerts too: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-degen. Also add a non-pager warning notification to #eng-platform for 65-50 window.

sam: Grafana panel query for cache ratio (Influx/Prom style):
```
avg_over_time(prefix_kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) / avg_over_time(prefix_kv_cache_requests_total[5m]) * 100
```
set alert if value < 65 for 5m. Panel should show model-route split and region filter.

jess: small UX ask for Console: when an alert fires, attach a "Quick actions" link that opens a modal with toggle to divert traffic to fallback-model and link to the rollout page. Ops wants this to be a 1-click mitigation.

kevin: agree. We'll need an internal API endpoint: POST /api/internal/v1/route-divert { route, from_model, to_model, reason } with auth service token. eng-platform + eng-runtime to implement.

anika: I'll create the alert PR in prometheus-alerts repo and include runbooks + pager mappings. Want me to add the soft quota alerts too? e.g. quota_usage > 70% warning, >90% throttled page.

maria: yes please. Soft quota warning -> notification only (channel + ticket); hard quota -> page to eng-oncall if it affects production throughput. Also include per-customer bucket label so support can triage.

sam: deploy-bot: can you create a dry-run of the rule set in staging and post link?

deploy-bot: new prometheus rules pushed to staging branch `alerts/kv-cache-metrics` — CI lint passed. Preview: https://ci.redwood/alerts/1769901111/preview :white_check_mark:

jess: for pager rotation, we should include escalation policies in the alert annotation. example: annotation.escalation: "eng-oncall (10m) -> eng-sre (30m)". Ops can parse that when creating PD incidents.

kevin: quick checklist before merging: 1) rule PR + runbook links 2) Alertmanager route changes (staging) 3) Console panel + quick-action link implemented behind feature flag 4) PD service keys stored in vault 5) Add unit tests for burnrate function in alerts lib

maria: timeline? want this out before the next customer rollout (2 weeks).

anika: I can have PRs open by EOD Tues, staging deploy Wed, feature flag QA Thu.

sam: I'll wire the PD test alerts to a test service and confirm routing.

jess: I'll spec the quick-action modal and make a tiny API contract doc for ENG runtime.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging followups: @anika (alerts PR), @kevin (route & PD keys), @jess (console UX), @sam (staging validation). :thumbsup:

kevin: one more: please add metric name aliases in the dashboard so onboarding folks see friendly labels (Cache Hit %, Batch P95 ms, Inflight HP).

anika: noted. I'll add panel descriptions and a short explanation blurb in the dashboard README.

deploy-bot: staging alert rules applied at 1769901400, test alert fired and routed to pagerduty test service at 1769901500. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/test/1769901500

maria: perfect. we'll validate during the next oncall rotation. closing here — will open PR links in this thread when ready. :eyes:
